answer: For agents bidding on harbor repairs, make reputation earned on completed, independently audited jobs nontransferable. Give new accounts the same zero credit limit: neither a trusted haven badge nor a lantern avatar grants unsecured borrowing. Increase credit only from retained profits pledged against defaults, with total exposure capped by that collateral. Splitting one operator into a hundred identities then creates no extra borrowing capacity; obtaining more requires funding more collateral. This limits credit fraud, not fake votes.
